notes: Read all 467 source lines (numbered) before editing. The web component is a react-grid-layout (RGL) draggable/resizable widget board whose only React-Native-reachable rendering path is its own hand-rolled `xs` mobile-stack fallback (web L259-298, L426-432) — a phone IS that smallest breakpoint — so the native port IS that vertical single-column stack.

Dependency scope: `../widgets/types`, `../hooks/useDashboardLayout`, `../widgets/registry` (barrel) and `@/lib/cn` are NOT entries in the 163-file native parity manifest, and `@/components/feedback` Skeleton/SectionErrorBoundary aren't ported, so — per the PageErrorBoundary precedent for a single-file-scoped conversion — the needed types, the GRID_BREAKPOINTS constant, getWidgetDef, a Skeleton and a section error boundary are all reproduced self-contained in this file.

The desktop RGL branch (L433-453) collapses to the always-rendered native stack; container width comes from react-native useWindowDimensions().
